versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

Blackboard One-Shot 0.1.1

- Initial release of the "blackboard-one-shot" skill.
- Converts each authorized blackboard photo and teacher-supplied facts into a single short, silent blackboard clip (2–15s).
- Clips are created separately and delivered in photo order—never stitched or edited together.
- Handles photo inspection, clip planning, price quoting, and pay-per-photo video generation via bundled MCP client tools only.
- Explicitly manages input requirements, confirmations, billing, credit top-ups, and recovery for each photo/task.
- Comprehensive documentation and workflow outlined in the new SKILL.md.
